item_name: Rothco Black Raider II Boot Knife
item_short_desc: Rothco's Black Raider II Boot Knife is a versatile and reliable tool designed for everyday carry. description: Rothco's Black Raider II Boot Knife is a versatile and reliable tool designed for everyday carry. The tactical knife features a durable 3-inch matte black stainless steel blade, crafted in a classic dagger style for precision and effectiveness. The sleek black finish adds an extra layer of protection against corrosion and wear. The included leather sheath with a clip and snap closure ensures the combat knife is securely stored and easily accessible. This sheath can be conveniently attached to your tactical boot, duty belt, utility pocket, or hiking backpack, making it an ideal choice for those who need a dependable utility knife on the go. The compact design of the Black Raider II Boot Knife, with an overall length of 6 ½ inches, makes it easy to carry without adding unnecessary bulk. Whether you're hiking, camping, or just need a reliable tool for everyday tasks, Rothco's Black Raider II Boot Knife delivers the performance and durability you need.
